stem: A distressed client says, “I don’t know how I’m going to handle everything.” Which nurse response is a therapeutic open-ended response?

options.A: “Tell me more about what concerns you most.”
options.B: “You should try not to worry about it.”
options.C: “Why are you letting this upset you so much?”

rationale: Open RN identifies open-ended questions/general leads as therapeutic communication because they allow the client to direct the conversation and encourage expression. Advice, challenging “why” questions, and false reassurance can block therapeutic communication.
educational_objective: Select an open-ended therapeutic response that encourages client expression.
source_document_title: Nursing: Mental Health and Community Concepts, 2nd ed. — Therapeutic Communication and the Nurse-Client Relationship

source_claim_supported: Open-ended questions encourage client expression; advice, challenging “why” questions, and false reassurance are nontherapeutic barriers.

audit_findings: A is the cited open-ended technique. B gives advice, C challenges with “why,” and D gives false reassurance. No second answer remains.
